findings.summary: contentText was added by editing migration_v1 SQL in place. Any already-initialized database lacks the column and will throw a Prisma runtime error on every PATCH that includes contentText. A new ALTER TABLE migration is required.

ReadingMaterialDisplay includes trailing punctuation (periods, commas, parentheses) in matched href values, producing broken links. Strip trailing punctuation with url.replace(/[.,;:!?)]+$/, '') before constructing the anchor.

handleSaveReading sets the shared error state which renders below video previews at the bottom of TopicMediaUploader, potentially below the fold. The error should appear inside the open editor panel adjacent to the Guardar/Cancelar buttons.

getContent returns all topic columns for enrolled students without explicitly handling contentText. If a preview for unenrolled students is ever added, contentText will be exposed. Consider adding it to the strip-down block in findDetail for unenrolled users.
